harness: cargo test --offline --locked -p fetchpath-lan; -p fetchpath-core --lib peer; -p fetchpath-cache --test cache_behaviour pinned_twice
scope: paired LAN mode: identity, pairing, sessions, serving, budget, and the core peer path
note: all networking is loopback TCP on one machine; no second physical device, no real LAN and no mDNS were involved. Pairing is not a PAKE. Peer retrieval is sequential and no speed claim is made. A trusted digest establishes representation identity, not publisher authenticity. An independent strong-model review of adapters/lan has not been performed.

a Credentialed entry and an absent entry receive the same not_available refusal; no bytes are sent and no file is created
a frame declaring 4 GiB is refused by the server before allocation
a malformed typed code is rejected locally and the host's code remains unspent
a paired peer retrieves a Public entry spanning several chunks byte-identically, and the upload releases its cache pin
the DPAPI-sealed identity reloads as the same key and is not stored as a raw seed
a client refuses a server whose key is not the pinned one it asked for
one flipped bit in an encrypted content frame is detected and the transfer fails
a code one character wrong fails confirmation on both sides and pins nothing
cache pins are reference-counted, so a peer upload and a local reuse cannot unpin each other
a code older than two minutes is refused and nothing is pinned
an offer above the receiver's declared ceiling is abandoned before any byte is read or any file created
an unpinned device receives exactly one refusal frame and not even the server's hello
an unreadable sealed identity is an error and the file is left untouched rather than replaced
presenting a pinned public key without its private key fails transcript authentication
a frame survives encoding and decoding
a 4 GiB declared length is refused before allocation
a truncated frame is an error, not a short read
an oversize payload is refused and nothing is written
a hello round-trips; a wrong version or length is refused
a refusal reason containing control characters is not echoed to people
an X25519 key producing an all-zero secret is refused
both sides derive the same X25519 shared secret
the transcript hash binds order, label and part boundaries
a public key round-trips through hex; malformed hex is refused
a signature verifies only for its message and its key
